name: agent-edge-glow
prompt: Effect: neon edge glow — detect edges in a first pass, blur them in a second pass, and add them back over the original layer in a third.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

definition.label: Neon Edge Glow

summary: I wrote "gen.neon-edge-glow" (group: Stylize), a three-pass effect that keeps a copy of the original layer. Pass 1 finds edges from brightness and transparency, pass 2 blurs them, and pass 3 adds them over the original as a sharp core plus a soft glow. Nothing was tested: there were no live tools here, so I couldn't run validate_effect, compile the GLSL or render frames. It also assumes pass numbering starts at 0 and that the original layer can be read in every pass.
